mechanism_read: Anchored retrieval preserved the strongest part of 277a: realistic future changes, realistic temporal moments, and realistic cross-cell structure.
The hard query-level re-anchor overcorrected the long-run level dynamics: mean reversion became too weak and jump-shape realism worsened.
The active bottleneck is now the retrieval metric itself. Raw L2 history similarity is not predictive enough of the right anchored future path.

decision.rationale: Keep retrieval, but replace the hand-fixed history-space distance with a learned similarity that is trained to retrieve future change paths better.
